tagline: Red rock, slickrock, and a road along a knife edge.
intro: Utah's Scenic Byway 12 runs between US-89 near Panguitch and Torrey, passing Red Canyon, Bryce Canyon, the town of Escalante, and Boulder Mountain. It crosses canyon country, slickrock plateaus, and high forest in a single drive.
Services are far apart on the middle stretch. Fill the tank and carry water.
season: Spring and autumn. Summer is hot at the low end and busy at Bryce.

moments.title: Red Canyon
moments.text: Red hoodoos and rock arches right beside the road at the west end.

moments.title: The Hogback
moments.text: Between Escalante and Boulder the road runs along a narrow ridge with drop-offs on both sides.

moments.title: Boulder Mountain
moments.text: The road climbs into aspen and conifer forest with views back over the desert.

sources.label: Utah Office of Tourism, Scenic Byway 12
